title: Transaction, v1 (server SDKs, performance)
description: One measured request or queued job, as a server SDK sends it when performance is on: POST /v1/transactions {"transactions": [<this>, …]} (at most 100, gzip with Content-Encoding: gzip), Authorization: Bearer <server secret>. A sample: the SDK keeps a share of them (sample_rate) and every slow or failed one. Never values: SQL keeps its shape only, a request is named by its route, not its URL. Sending one again is harmless (the id is the key).

name.description: A request: its method and route template ("GET /posts/{post}"). A job: its class.

occurred_at.description: When it started: ISO 8601 with milliseconds and offset. A future one is placed at now; one older than the service keeps figures is refused.

failed.description: A job that threw, or a request answered 5xx.

kept.description: Why the SDK sent it: drawn by sample_rate, over the slow threshold, or failed. Only a drawn one stands for others (1 / sample_rate of them).

sample_rate.description: The share of ordinary ones the SDK sends: 0.1 = one in ten.

queries.description: Its heaviest queries by time, grouped by shape: the SQL with every value replaced by ? and an IN list cut to (?).

n_plus_one.description: A query of one shape run 5 times or more: one query per row, where one query for all rows would do.

origin.description: The host's own line that ran it ("app/Http/Controllers/PostController.php:24").
